title: app-shell + i18n: add the `reports` translation group objectstack #25788 adds — TranslationPreview's CATEGORY_DEFS fails type-check at the next pin, and the console loader does not recognise a reports-only payload
body:
Filing gate ④: the consumer-half child card of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25788 (cross-repo; the parent's business reason carries over: HotCRM's ten reports list in English under zh-CN, and the fix declares a translation key for them). Filed by the objectstack os-dev for #25788 · `session_01BUeRMD4VYCYUfzxTKcZFAF`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat. One small PR once the objectstack PR for #25788 (branch `claude/project-thread-uzjpca`, "reports are translatable") is merged, moving objectui's `.objectstack-sha` past it. The precedent is objectui#13478 / objectui#13485 (`positions` / `permissions`, objectstack `47af3dde42`).

## What changes upstream

objectstack #25788 adds a `reports` group to the per-app `TranslationDataSchema` (so also to `GetTranslationsResponseSchema.shape.translations` and the platform bundle), keyed by report `name`, each `{ label?, description? }`. The server applies it to `GET /meta/report` (list and item) itself, so the console's report index, report page heading, header breadcrumb and recent-items label already arrive translated with no objectui change. What breaks is objectui's two exhaustive copies of the group list.

## Measured (objectui `main` `699156a`, read against the objectstack branch)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx:84-105`: `CATEGORY_DEFS` is `satisfies Record<TranslationGroup, …>` with `TranslationGroup = keyof (typeof TranslationDataSchema)['shape']` (`:74`). With `reports` in the shape and no row here, `@object-ui/app-shell` fails type-check (TS1360, `… is missing the following properties: reports`), the same failure objectui#13478 recorded for `positions` / `permissions`; objectstack's scheduled `Console Pin Gate` goes red the same way.
- `packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts:76-98`: `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` lacks `reports`. `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx:71-86` walks the spec's own key list and requires a payload carrying any one group alone (`{ reports: {} }`) to take the transform branch, so that test goes red at the pin move. (A real payload also carries `objects` and is transformed today; `transformSpecTranslations` copies unknown top-level groups through, so `reportLabel`'s client-side `reports.<name>.label` lookup in `appReportIndex.ts` already resolves.)

## Wanted

- A `reports` row in `CATEGORY_DEFS`, in the schema's order (after `datasets`), with label key `engine.translationPreview.category.reports` and an icon; add the key to every locale pack in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.
- `'reports'` in `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS`, with the same provenance comment the `positions` / `permissions` entries carry.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` passes against an objectstack `packages/spec` that carries the `reports` group; move `.objectstack-sha` to or past that merge in the same PR and say so.
- `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx` and `TranslationPreview.categories-11765.test.tsx` green at that pin; `check:i18n-keys` green with the new key.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS reports translation group console report label translated" → 1 hit (#11782, closed, the field inspector label hint, unrelated); "TranslationPreview CATEGORY_DEFS reports group translation preview" → 6 hits (#11765, objectstack-ai/objectui#11755, objectstack-ai/objectui#10848, objectstack-ai/objectui#13221, objectstack-ai/objectui#10862, objectstack-ai/objectui#3134, all closed, none about `reports`). **New.**
